nodes.name: Hermes Authenticate
nodes.notes: POST /api/authenticate {username,password} -> { access_token }. Creds from n8n ENV (HERMES_BASE_URL / HERMES_USERNAME / HERMES_PASSWORD).

nodes.name: Hermes POST Catalogue
nodes.notes: POST /api/productsCatalogue { items:[...] } — ONE request for the whole selection. 200 ok / 401 bad token / 422 processing error {msg,error}. Inserts new EANs; existing EANs are reported as skipped. NB the endpoint is all-or-nothing: a batch holding an existing EAN can come back status 0 with the new items NOT inserted, so Map Sent marks sent only what Hermes confirmed.
